tools.name: get_freebuff_status
tools.description: Check whether Freebuff is installed, connected, authorized, and which actions this bridge can perform. A detected app may still be signed out or read-only.

tools.name: freebuff_status
tools.description: Compatibility name for get_freebuff_status. Returns the same connection, authorization, and supported-action report.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List project records visible to the selected Freebuff backend. Use a returned project id or path with project file tools.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List threads visible to Freebuff, optionally filtered to one project id or path. Use get_thread for one thread or get_active_work for nonterminal work.

projectId.description: Project id or exact project path returned by list_projects.

tools.name: list_threads_page
tools.description: List a bounded page of visible threads, optionally filtered to one project. Continue with nextOffset while hasMore is true; use list_threads for the full list in one response.

projectId.description: Project id or exact project path returned by list_projects.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for paging through the current visible result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read metadata for one Freebuff thread, including fields the backend exposes. Use get_thread_messages for conversation text or get_thread_settings for model and reasoning settings.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: get_thread_settings
tools.description: Read the model, harness, and reasoning effort reported for a thread. Missing fields are reported as unavailable, never inferred.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: get_thread_messages
tools.description: Read all messages that the selected Freebuff backend exposes for one thread. Large conversations can produce large results; use get_thread_messages_page for bounded paging.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: get_thread_messages_page
tools.description: Read a bounded page of messages from one thread. Continue with the returned nextOffset while hasMore is true; use get_thread_messages to retrieve the full history in one response.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for paging through the current visible result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_active_work
tools.description: Find visible threads whose reported turn state is not idle or terminal. Returns an empty list when no active work is visible; use list_threads to include idle threads.

tools.name: get_turn
tools.description: Read the bridge’s canonical state and a bounded page of recent events for one turn. Use watch_turn to wait for an update or continue from a later sequence.

turnId.description: Turn id returned by send_message or run_turn.

afterSequence.description: Return events after this sequence number; use the last received sequence to continue paging.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_thread_progress
tools.description: Read a bounded snapshot of events and state tracked by this bridge for one thread. Use watch_thread to wait for the next update.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

afterSequence.description: Return events after this sequence number; use the last received sequence to continue paging.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: watch_thread
tools.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for bridge-tracked progress after a sequence number. Poll again with the last event sequence to continue; use get_thread_progress for a non-waiting snapshot.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

afterSequence.description: Return events after this sequence number; use the last received sequence to continue paging.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds, from 0 to 30000.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: get_thread_progress_summary
tools.description: Return one compact bridge-tracked progress snapshot without raw event detail. Use get_thread_progress when event-level data is needed.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: watch_turn
tools.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for a canonical turn update. Use the returned sequence to request only newer events; get_turn gives the current state without waiting.

turnId.description: Turn id returned by send_message or run_turn.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds, from 0 to 30000.

afterSequence.description: Return events after this sequence number; use the last received sequence to continue paging.

tools.name: watch_active_threads
tools.description: Return compact bridge progress snapshots for threads with tracked activity. This does not discover idle or untracked Freebuff threads; use list_threads for backend discovery.

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.description: List files the bridge permits reading inside a project returned by list_projects. Optionally limit the result to a relative subdirectory.

projectId.description: Project id or exact project path returned by list_projects.

relative.description: Optional directory path relative to the selected project root.

tools.name: get_project_file
tools.description: Read one safe, redacted file inside a project returned by list_projects. The path must stay inside that project root.

projectId.description: Project id or exact project path returned by list_projects.

path.description: Path relative to the selected project root. Absolute paths and escapes are rejected.

tools.name: read_project_file
tools.description: Compatibility name for get_project_file. Reads one safe, redacted file inside a project returned by list_projects.

projectId.description: Project id or exact project path returned by list_projects.

path.description: Path relative to the selected project root. Absolute paths and escapes are rejected.

tools.name: list_thread_attachments
tools.description: List attachment metadata exposed by the backend that owns this thread. Returns metadata only and does not download attachment contents; the CLI currently does not expose attachments.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: get_model_catalog_status
tools.description: Check whether this Freebuff installation exposes a standalone model catalog. The current Desktop and CLI backends do not enumerate models; use get_thread_settings to read a selected thread or set_model to request a change.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Compatibility name for get_model_catalog_status. Reports whether this installation can enumerate models; it does not return a model list.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Search visible Freebuff thread metadata using a case-insensitive substring. This does not search message bodies or hidden local history files. The compatibility-shaped result is capped at 100; use search_threads_page when more matches may exist.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in visible thread metadata, limited to 200 characters.

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Compatibility name for search_threads. Searches visible thread metadata, not conversation messages or hidden local history files. Results are capped at 100; use search_threads_page when more matches may exist.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in visible thread metadata, limited to 200 characters.

tools.name: search_threads_page
tools.description: Search visible thread metadata and return one bounded page of matches. This does not search message bodies or hidden history; continue with nextOffset while hasMore is true.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in visible thread metadata, limited to 200 characters.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for paging through the current visible result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: search_thread_messages
tools.description: Search messages exposed for one thread. Returns matching message excerpts only, capped at the requested limit; it does not search other threads or hidden history.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in visible thread metadata, limited to 200 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, from 1 to 100.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Create a bridge session in the selected project, or attach to an existing Freebuff conversation. The result includes a sessionId and, when provided by Freebuff, a threadId.

cwd.description: Absolute project directory to use as the session working directory.

continueConversationId.description: Existing Freebuff conversation id to attach this bridge session to.

tools.name: start_thread
tools.description: Compatibility name for create_thread. Creates a bridge session or attaches to an existing conversation and returns the identifiers needed by later tools.

cwd.description: Absolute project directory to use as the session working directory.

continueConversationId.description: Existing Freebuff conversation id to attach this bridge session to.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Queue a request on an existing bridge session and return immediately with a turnId. Pass sessionId or threadId, or omit both to create a session in the configured project. Poll get_turn or watch_turn for progress and the final result; Freebuff may edit files or run commands.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

sessionId.description: Bridge session id returned by create_thread.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

tools.name: run_turn
tools.description: Send a request to Freebuff and wait for a terminal turn result while reporting MCP progress. Pass sessionId or threadId, or omit both to create a session in the configured project. Cancellation asks the owning backend to stop; the result distinguishes confirmed stops, waiting states, and rate limits. Freebuff may edit files or run commands.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

sessionId.description: Bridge session id returned by create_thread.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

text.description: Request text to send to Freebuff. The agent may edit project files or run commands.

tools.name: stop_turn
tools.description: Cancel a bridge-tracked turn for the given session and ask its owning backend to stop. The result says whether the backend confirmed the stop; a local cancellation alone is not confirmation.

sessionId.description: Bridge session id returned by create_thread.

turnId.description: Turn id returned by send_message or run_turn.

tools.name: stop_thread
tools.description: Ask Freebuff to stop work for a bridge session or known thread. Supply exactly one of sessionId or threadId; stopping an unknown thread requires creating or attaching a bridge session first.

sessionId.description: Bridge session id returned by create_thread.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: resume_thread
tools.description: Ask the owning Freebuff backend to resume a paused thread. For CLI conversations outside the current project, pass the original cwd. Resume may continue work that edits files or runs commands, and uncertain outcomes remain marked as unconfirmed.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

sessionId.description: Bridge session id returned by create_thread.

cwd.description: Absolute project directory to use as the session working directory.

tools.name: set_model
tools.description: Request a model change for a thread already known to this bridge. The selected backend validates the model; use get_thread_settings to read the reported value afterward.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

model.description: Exact model id accepted by the selected Freebuff thread.

harnessId.description: Freebuff harness id to pair with the selected model, when needed.

tools.name: set_reasoning
tools.description: Request a reasoning effort change for a thread already known to this bridge. Pass null to clear the override; use get_thread_settings to read the reported value afterward.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

effort.description: Reasoning effort accepted by the selected Freebuff thread; null clears the override.

tools.name: get_changed_files
tools.description: List unique file paths observed in this bridge’s recent progress events for a thread. This event-derived list may not include earlier or unreported changes.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Read Freebuff Desktop’s change summary for a thread, including changed paths and line totals when the installed version exposes the route. Use get_diff for per-file patch text.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

scope.description: Change range to inspect. all includes the full thread history; uncommitted limits results to current uncommitted work.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Read actual per-file patch text from Freebuff Desktop when supported. The result identifies whether file paths came from Desktop, bridge events, or no source, and reports when a requested file was not found. Event-derived paths may not cover earlier changes.

threadId.description: Freebuff thread id returned by list_threads or create_thread.

file.description: Optional exact changed-file path to limit diff output.

scope.description: Change range to inspect. all includes the full thread history; uncommitted limits results to current uncommitted work.
